Application Materials.content:
Only completed applications will be assessed. An application is considered complete when the online application is completed and required supporting documents are uploaded.
Your application should demonstrate:
- Strong intellectual capability
- Solid career progression
- Professional achievements
- Leadership potential
- Cultural sensitivity
The essay questions are compulsory and you should articulate your thoughts clearly, using good judgement with respect to the word limit. No separate application for scholarships is required; tick the box relating to the scholarship you are applying for in the online application form and complete the essay for scholarship consideration.
Upload the following supporting documents:
- **CV or Resume**: Concise document no more than 3 pages, briefly describing your responsibilities and accomplishments.
- **Educational Documents**: Degree scroll/certificate(s) and academic transcripts of each university attended; official English translation is required for non-English certificates and transcripts.
- **Passport Photo**: Coloured photo taken within the last 3 months, in hi-resolution jpeg format.
- **Passport or NRIC**: International applicants must have a valid passport on hand for video identification within the application. Singapore Citizens and SPR should use NRIC. Applicants are also required to upload a scanned copy of passport or NRIC.
- **GMAT/GMAT Focus or GRE Score (Optional)**: You may upload your unofficial or test taker copy if you do not have your official test scores on hand. Arrange to have official test scores sent to Nanyang Business School.
- **TOEFL or IELTS score report**: Required if English was not the medium of instruction used during the undergraduate or bachelor’s degree. Applicants who have yet to take the TOEFL/IELTS may still submit the application and indicate the test dates in the online application form.
- **Referee Reports**: Applicants are required to nominate two referees in the online application form. Upon nomination, an online referee report form will be sent to them for completion. All referee reports must be submitted from an official institution or organisational email address; submissions from personal email addresses will not be accepted.
- **Professional Membership Certificates, if any**.
Scholarship applicants should complete the scholarship part of the online application, including the scholarship essay. Scholarship applications must be completed, including submission of all supporting documents, by the round 1 deadline and submitted together with the application.

Interview Requirements.content: After assessment of your application is completed, candidates will be shortlisted for the interview. The interview is **by invitation only** and shortlisted candidates will be informed via e-mail. The announcement of shortlisted candidates will be made after the deadline of the application round and is not a one-time exercise; subsequent announcements will also be made as warranted. Admissions interviews for shortlisted candidates will be recorded as part of the selection process. Candidates who have successfully completed the interview will move to the final selection stage, where the Admissions Committee will deliberate and select candidates for admission. For the MSc Actuarial and Risk Analytics Merit Scholarship, eligibility criteria include having **performed well in the admission interview**.

Application Deadlines.content:
The MARA programme will start in July. The application for the July 2026 intake will start in September 2025. Applications are reviewed on a rolling basis, and early application improves your chances of being shortlisted sooner.
- Round 1: **30 November 2025**
- Round 2: **31 January 2026**
- Round 3: **31 March 2026**

Academic Requirements.content:
To apply for the MSc Actuarial and Risk Analytics (MARA) programme, applicants need to meet the following minimum admission requirements:
- **A good undergraduate degree in any discipline**.
- **Work experience is not required**.
The above are minimum admission requirements. Meeting these criteria does not guarantee admission, as selection is competitive.

GRE GMAT Requirements.content:
- GMAT or GRE score is optional.
- The institution codes are: GMAT: V24-ZV-40; GRE: 3123.
- **GMAT/GMAT Focus or GRE Score (Optional):** You may upload your unofficial or test taker copy if you do not have your official test scores on hand. Please arrange to have your official test scores sent to Nanyang Business School. Our GMAT institution code is V24-ZV-40 and our GRE ID code is 3123.
- **Important:** We no longer accept GMAT/GRE online test scores taken **after 31 December 2023**. Only in-person test results are considered valid.

English Proficiency Requirements.content:
IELTS or TOEFL is required if the medium of instruction during your undergraduate studies was not exclusively in English.
An acceptable score for TOEFL is **100 (internet based)**. For IELTS, the acceptable score is **6.5 and above**. *TOEFL/IELTS score has a validity period of **two years**.

Program Overview.content:
Build a career at the intersection of finance, risk, and sustainability with the MSc Actuarial and Risk Analytics programme. Blending actuarial science, risk management, and sustainability insights, this interdisciplinary programme equips you to succeed in a world defined by rapid change and complex challenges. You will gain the analytical expertise and strategic mindset needed to manage emerging risks, respond to environmental shifts, and drive responsible decision-making across industries. The programme’s practical, hands-on approach ensures you apply what you learn to real business scenarios, giving you the skills and experience to launch a career in actuarial science, risk consulting, insurance, finance, and beyond.
MARA is offered as a full-time, one-year programme. The programme is delivered entirely in English on the vibrant main campus at Nanyang Technological University in Singapore.
The demand for actuarial and risk analytics professionals continues to grow, as organisations seek experts who can assess uncertainty, manage financial risks, and support data-driven decision-making. Employers value graduates who are proficient in statistical modelling, risk assessment, and the application of quantitative insights across sectors such as insurance, finance, consulting and beyond.
The programme also offers an optional six-month internship, which can be undertaken as part of the curriculum. This provides participants with valuable, hands-on exposure to real-world risk challenges, strengthening their career prospects as actuaries, risk analysts, and consultants, while preparing them for professional actuarial accreditation.

Curriculum.content:
MARA is offered as a full-time, one-year programme. The programme is delivered entirely in English on the vibrant main campus at Nanyang Technological University in Singapore.
#### Core Modules
- [**Database and Programming for Actuarial and Risk Analyst**](https://www.ntu.edu.sg/business/admissions/graduate-studies/msc-actuarial-risk-analytics/programme-overview#Content_C021_Col00): This module aims to equip students with a comprehensive understanding of database management and programming concepts relevant to actuarial science and risk management.
- [**Enterprise Risk Management**](https://www.ntu.edu.sg/business/admissions/graduate-studies/msc-actuarial-risk-analytics/programme-overview#Content_C015_Col00): This module offers a comprehensive introduction to enterprise risk management, harmonizing quantitative and qualitative approaches.
- [**Financial Markets and Products**](https://www.ntu.edu.sg/business/admissions/graduate-studies/msc-actuarial-risk-analytics/programme-overview#Content_C019_Col00): This module introduces the financial markets as well as basic financial products with a focus on derivatives.
- [**Foundation of Quantitative Risk Management**](https://www.ntu.edu.sg/business/admissions/graduate-studies/msc-actuarial-risk-analytics/programme-overview#Content_C022_Col00): This module introduces necessary analytical tools for risk management.
- [**Modern Risk and Actuarial Theory**](https://www.ntu.edu.sg/business/admissions/graduate-studies/msc-actuarial-risk-analytics/programme-overview#Content_C023_Col00): This module introduces fundamental principles of risk management and actuarial theory.
- [**Principles of Climate Risk and Carbon Markets**](https://www.ntu.edu.sg/business/admissions/graduate-studies/msc-actuarial-risk-analytics/programme-overview#Content_C020_Col00): This module brings a general introduction to Climate Risk and Carbon markets.
#### Elective Modules
- [**Advanced Quantitative Risk Management**](https://www.ntu.edu.sg/business/admissions/graduate-studies/msc-actuarial-risk-analytics/programme-overview#Content_C014_Col00): This module introduces diverse quantitative disciplines essential for market, credit, and operational risk modeling.
- [**Credit Risk Analytics**](https://www.ntu.edu.sg/business/admissions/graduate-studies/msc-actuarial-risk-analytics/programme-overview#Content_C016_Col00): This module provides introduction to credit risk, the reasons it arises, and describes quantitative measurements and factors of credit risk.
- [**Financial Mathematics**](https://www.ntu.edu.sg/business/admissions/graduate-studies/msc-actuarial-risk-analytics/programme-overview#Content_C018_Col00): This module covers the basics of financial valuation, including the most important financial concept, the time value of money.
- [**Portfolio Risk Analytics**](https://www.ntu.edu.sg/business/admissions/graduate-studies/msc-actuarial-risk-analytics/programme-overview#Content_C013_Col00): This module covers topics of different analytical methods for portfolio management.
- [**Quantitative Climate Risk Analytics**](https://www.ntu.edu.sg/business/admissions/graduate-studies/msc-actuarial-risk-analytics/programme-overview#Content_C017_Col00): This module will introduce state-of-the-art analytical tools for measuring and modelling climate-related risks.
- [**Sustainable Finance and Risk Management**](https://www.ntu.edu.sg/business/admissions/graduate-studies/msc-actuarial-risk-analytics/programme-overview#Content_C012_Col00): This module introduces how to incorporate general risk management techniques into sustainable risk management.
The programme also offers an optional six-month internship, which can be undertaken as part of the curriculum.

Financial Aid.content:
No separate application for scholarships is required – simply tick on the box relating to the scholarship you are applying for in the online application form and complete the essay for scholarship consideration.
#### **MSc Actuarial And Risk Analytics Merit Scholarship**
NBS offers partial scholarships to stellar candidates, on a competitive basis. Only applicants who have been offered a place in MSc in Actuarial and Risk Analytics programme are eligible for the scholarships. The partial scholarship will go towards off-setting the fees of the programme, and does not cover the living expenses in Singapore, travel, and accommodation.​
#### ​Eligibility Criteria
- Possess excellent academic credentials
- Performed well in the admission interview
- Granted admission to the MSc in Actuarial and Risk Analytics programme
#### How to Apply
- Please complete the scholarship part of the online application, including the scholarship essay.
- Applicants who wish to be considered for the scholarship should ensure that their scholarship applications are completed (including submission of all supporting documents) by [round 1 deadline](https://www.ntu.edu.sg/index).
- Scholarship application will only be considered when it is submitted together with the application.
#### **ASEAN Development Scholarship**
This partial scholarship is awarded to nationals of ASEAN member countries (excluding Singapore) as part of NBS’s effort to accelerate economic and social progress in the Member States of ASEAN. Recipients may receive up to 90% funding towards their tuition fees.
#### Eligibility Criteria
Scholarship applicants must possess strong academic records, demonstrated leadership qualities and potential, and for working professionals, a strong career progression.
#### How to Apply
A complete online application including the scholarship section, and required supporting documents must be submitted by the [first round](https://www.ntu.edu.sg/index) application deadline to be eligible for the ASEAN Development Scholarship.
#### Diversity Scholarship
The Diversity Scholarship aims to cultivate a vibrant community by supporting individuals who bring unique perspectives and experiences to the programme and the NBS community. Diversity encompasses a broad range of dimensions, including but not limited to ethnicity, gender, and cultural heritage. Scholarship applicants are encouraged to define diversity in a way that reflects their personal journeys and experiences. Each scholarship awarded covers 40% of the tuition fees.
#### Eligibility Criteria
Applicants must showcase a distinctive background, demonstrate how it enhances the broader understanding of diversity, and possess a track record of success in initiatives or activities that promote diversity within their communities or workplaces.
#### How to Apply
A complete online application including the scholarship section, and required supporting documents must be submitted by the [first round of application deadline](https://www.ntu.edu.sg/index) to be eligible for the Diversity Scholarship.
#### **NTU Alumni Grant**
NTU alumni who have completed a bachelor’s or post-graduate degree at NTU are eligible for an alumni grant of 10% of the tuition fees. The subsidy can only be used to offset the tuition fee and cannot be used to offset other costs such as student service fees or miscellaneous fees.​
#### **Singapore Citizen & Singapore PR Grant**
Singapore Citizens and Singapore Permanent Residents are eligible for a grant of S$5,000, with those awarded financial aid getting up to S$10,000. The subsidy can only be used to offset the tuition fee and cannot be used to offset other costs such as student service fees or miscellaneous fees. To be eligible for financial aid, applicants must have a monthly PCI of less than S$2,500 or a gross household income of less than S$10,000. Financial aid is subject to a successful application.

Multiple Applications.content:
- Applicants has to use the same application number if applying for more than one programme in the same intake (i.e. August intake). For applications under different intake, please use a new application number.
- Application fee will be charged for each Coursework application.
- Application fee payment can be made online before submitting application by VISA/Mastercard. Please ensure that application fee is made to the correct Coursework Application Number (eg C22xxxxx) and programme code. Application fee payment is non-transferable and non-refundable.

Deferral Admission Policy.content: Yes, you may request for a deferment. However, you must accept the course offer and make the enrolment deposit before request for a deferment can be made.

Conditional Admission Policy.content:
A conditional offer is extended to an applicant who is in the process of completing the final term, semester, or trimester of their current course of study, and has outstanding educational documents. This condition will be clearly outlined in the offer letter, stating: 'The offer of admission is on condition that you obtain your Bachelor's degree with a ________ from ___________ , ___________ "
- **International Student with International Qualification**: Official degree certificate and final transcript; Digital copy of Student Pass (Full-time students) / Valid immigration pass (For Part-time students only); Degree verification report (English) from NTU approved credential verification agency **within one month of your term start date**; Latest Passport (If not yet submitted).
- **International Student with Local (Singapore) Qualification**: Official degree certificate and final transcript; Digital copy of Student Pass (Full-time students) / Valid immigration pass (For Part-time students only); Degree verification screen capture from respective local university online degree verification portal; Latest Passport (If not yet submitted).
- **Singapore Citizen / Singapore Permanent Resident with International Qualification**: Official degree certificate and final transcript; Degree verification report (English) from NTU approved credential verification agency.
- **Singapore Citizen / Singapore Permanent Resident with Local (Singapore) Qualification**: Official degree certificate and final transcript; Degree verification screen capture from respective local university online degree verification portal.
For **Conditional Offer** (i.e. subject to attaining a Bachelor/ Masters’ degree), you are required to upload your **Bachelor/ Masters’ degree scrolls and Official Transcript** (Original and English Language translated). If you are unable to upload your Bachelor/ Masters’ degree scroll during verification period, you are to upload **a letter of completion** from your university stating that you have completed and attained Bachelor/ Masters’ degree. **Do not complete e-verification if you do not meet the condition stated on the offer letter.** Kindly contact your school for assistance.
